source_units.text: Draft instructions to accompany an invented paper-folding diagram.
Use a calm and explicit voice.
Use this fictional material: The paper-folding step brings the marked corner to the center crease.
Press only the lower half of the fold and keep the flap loose so it can open into a pocket in the next step.
Required wording, verbatim: "marked corner", "center crease", "keep the flap loose".
Go ahead immediately; use your judgment for any remaining stylistic choice.
